categories.main_business_segments: Maxio Technology (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: data storage controller chips and AIoT signal processing and transmission chips. The company designs and sells integrated circuit chips, focusing on SSD controller chips for consumer, industrial, and enterprise applications, as well as AIoT chips used in smart home, automotive electronics, industrial IoT, and public IoT sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced SoC chip architecture design, algorithm design, digital and analog IP design, and comprehensive chip development platforms. It has proprietary technologies including advanced error correction codes (LDPC, BCH, RS), high-speed interface IPs (SATA, PCIe, USB, DDR), data security IPs, and automated testing systems. Production follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include SSD module manufacturers, PC OEMs, server and system integrators, and AIoT device manufacturers. The company serves global markets with products applied in consumer electronics, industrial control, data communication, smart homes, automotive electronics, and public infrastructure sectors. Major clients include both domestic and international brands, with significant sales to top five customers accounting for over 78% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: Maxio Technology operates primarily in China, with its headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has a significant presence in both domestic and overseas markets, with over 40% of revenue generated from outside mainland China, covering more than 60 countries and regions globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a fabless semiconductor design firm, focusing on upstream design and development of integrated circuits. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized third-party foundries and service providers, positioning itself in the midstream design segment of the semiconductor supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in PCIe 5.0 SSD controller chips and embedded storage controllers (UFS/eMMC), expansion in AIoT signal processing and transmission chips, and development of automotive-grade and Ethernet PHY chips. The company emphasizes R&D investment, with over 36% of revenue allocated to research, focusing on low power consumption, high performance, integration, and expanding application scenarios in AI, 5G, and IoT.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-designed integrated circuit chips and related technical services such as chip design and firmware customization. The company employs a sales model dominated by direct sales to end customers, supplemented by distributor sales, with revenue recognized upon transfer of control of goods or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Maxio Technology is a leading independent SSD controller chip provider globally, competing with major players such as Silicon Motion, Realtek, and other NAND manufacturers' in-house controller teams. It holds approximately 22% market share in the independent SSD controller segment and is recognized for its strong technology and market presence. In AIoT chips, it is an emerging player facing competition from established international giants like Marvell and Realtek.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.17 billion, representing a 13.55% year-over-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 118 million, a 126% increase. Total assets grew significantly to over RMB 2.08 billion, supported by a successful IPO raising over RMB 1 billion. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment and expanding market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Maxio Technology emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, including advanced error correction, high-speed interfaces, and integrated SoC designs that deliver high performance, low power consumption, and strong reliability. Its diversified product portfolio spans consumer to industrial applications, supported by a robust R&D platform and a comprehensive supply chain. The company’s integrated chip solutions enable customers to achieve superior data storage performance and intelligent IoT connectivity, differentiating it in competitive global markets.
